axeViolations.description: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text in a way that does not rely on color
axeViolations.help: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color

any.message: The link has insufficient color contrast of 2.02:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #404040, surrounding text: #000000)

any.message: The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text

nodes.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 2.02:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #404040, surrounding text: #000000)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
